% The finished blue-accent CV (Word design, #2563EB) converted into a builder
% template with as few changes as possible. Everything visual — colours,
% margins, section rules, list spacing, header layout — is untouched.
%
% The six changes the builder forces:
%  1. \input{glyphtounicode} and \pdfgentounicode=1 removed: \input is a
%     blocked primitive and the flag is useless without that file.
%  2. 9pt -> 10pt: article has no 9pt option, pdflatex silently ignores it.
%  3. The color package dropped: xcolor already provides everything it did.
%  4. Personal data replaced by the eight {{placeholders}}.
%  5. Résumé / Projets / Langues sections removed: they have no placeholder,
%     and a template must print each USER's data, never the author's. When
%     filling the CV, fold that content into the headline / experience /
%     skills fields.
%  6. The four-argument \resumeSubheading macro cannot be fed by one merged
%     string (Experience arrives as a single text block), so entries render
%     through \resumeItem inside the very same list settings the original
%     body used — same leftmargin, itemsep and topsep.
%
% Verified in the real sandbox: compiles to ONE page with the sample data.
% Placeholders: {{fullName}} {{headline}} {{email}} {{phone}} {{links}}
%               {{experience}} {{education}} {{profile}} {{certificates}} {{skills}}
\documentclass[letterpaper,10pt]{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{latexsym}
\usepackage[empty]{fullpage}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{marvosym}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage[colorlinks=true]{hyperref}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{tabularx}

% Blue accent matching the Word version (#2563EB)
\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{2563EB}
\definecolor{navy}{HTML}{1F2937}
\definecolor{greytext}{HTML}{555555}

\hypersetup{
  linkcolor=accent,
  urlcolor=accent,
  citecolor=accent,
}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

% Margins
\addtolength{\oddsidemargin}{-0.55in}
\addtolength{\evensidemargin}{-0.55in}
\addtolength{\textwidth}{1.1in}
\addtolength{\topmargin}{-0.6in}
\addtolength{\textheight}{1.3in}

\urlstyle{same}
\raggedright
\raggedbottom
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0in}

% Section titles — blue, matching Word headers
\titleformat{\section}{
  \vspace{-1pt}\color{accent}\scshape\raggedright\large
}{}{0em}{}[\color{accent}\titlerule \vspace{-1pt}]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{6pt}{4pt}

% Custom commands — kept from the original; the list macros carry the same
% spacing options the finished CV used for its body lists.
\newcommand{\resumeItem}[1]{\item\small{{#1}}}
\newcommand{\resumeListStart}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.18in, label={}, itemsep=1.2pt, topsep=2.5pt, parsep=0pt]}
\newcommand{\resumeListEnd}{\end{itemize}\vspace{-2pt}}

\begin{document}

% ---------- HEADER ----------
\begin{center}
    \textbf{\Huge \scshape \color{navy} {{fullName}}} \\[3pt]
    \small \textbf{\color{accent} {{headline}}} \\[3pt]
    \footnotesize \color{greytext}
    {{phone}} $\quad|\quad$ {{email}} \\[2pt]
    {{links}}
\end{center}
\vspace{4pt}

% ---------- PROFILE ----------
\section{Profil}
\resumeListStart
\resumeItem{ {{profile}} }
\resumeListEnd
\vspace{-2pt}

% ---------- EXPERIENCE ----------
\section{Expérience}
\resumeListStart
\resumeItem{ {{experience}} }
\resumeListEnd

% ---------- TECHNICAL SKILLS ----------
\section{Compétences Techniques}
\resumeListStart
\resumeItem{ {{skills}} }
\resumeListEnd

% ---------- EDUCATION ----------
\section{Formation}
\resumeListStart
\resumeItem{ {{education}} }
\resumeListEnd

% ---------- CERTIFICATES ----------
% One line per certificate: "Cert Name, Issuer (year)".
\section{Certificats}
\resumeListStart
\resumeItem{ {{certificates}} }
\resumeListEnd

\end{document}
